verdict.rationale: LightSprint documents real sandbox isolation rather than a dry-run mode: each task gets an isolated full-stack sandbox with a branched database when needed, and live previews run without affecting production. Its docs also describe network egress controls on those isolated sandboxes. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how database branching and data seeding work, and independent or hands-on corroboration of production-data isolation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: every task on your board its own full-stack environment: an isolated sandbox with a branched database when needed
